LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 14.3.1 ADVERBS OF PLACE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we identify different positions of things in the classroom? 2. How do we identify an adverb of place from a sentence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise the adverbs of place in sentences to show awareness,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use adverbs of place to describe the position of objects and people for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the proper use of adverbs of place to describe • Learners with low vision are guided to identify different positions of things in the classroom while learners with blindness be given one on one support and clear verbal description different positions of things in the classroom to walk around the classroom and identify positions of real objects in the classroom by sense of touch. • Learners are guided to individually point out the adverbs of place in sentences. • Learners are guided to individually practise using adverbs of place to construct sentences 1. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn- learner’s independent learning is enhanced as they practise using adverbs of place in sentences to complete the task in time.

• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and correctly is enhanced as they use adverbs of place to describe the

position of objects and people.

Values:
Responsibility: Accountability is enhanced as the learner keeps classroom objects in the right places.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self –esteem) learner’s esteem is enhanced as they use the knowledge of adverbs of place to describe the position of objects and people.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner uses the knowledge on adverbs to learn similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.

• Textbooks in appropriate print
